call_rule: A change is called when it is at least 2× and the p-value is below 0.05.

rules.solid: Same call in at least 95 of 100 reasonable analyses, no 5 or fewer samples change it, and the difference is clear in at least 95 of 100.
rules.holds with caveats: Same call in at least 95 of 100 reasonable analyses, but 5 or fewer samples change it, or the difference is not always clear.
rules.depends on your choices: Same call in 80 to 95 of 100 reasonable analyses: the rest depend on the choices made.
rules.fragile: Same call in fewer than 80 of 100 reasonable analyses, or 2 or fewer samples change it, or it sits within 7 % of the 2× line.
rules.check data first: A problem found in the data changes this call when it is fixed.
rules.no call: Not called a change: a call needs at least 2× and a p-value below 0.05.

not_run: small experiments drawn from the data
